cards.target: Partout dans la ville on entendait de la musique.

cards.target: Je cherchais un restaurant quand j'ai trouvé ce petit bistrot.

cards.target: Il faisait très froid et nous avons allumé le chauffage.
cards.english: It was very cold and we turned on the heating.

cards.target: Je faisais mes devoirs quand ma mère m'a appelé pour dîner.
cards.english: I was doing my homework when my mother called me for dinner.

cards.target: Il neigeait et les enfants ont décidé de faire un bonhomme de neige.
cards.english: It was snowing and the children decided to make a snowman.

cards.target: Ils craignaient les orages.
cards.english: They were afraid of storms.

cards.target: Nous riions beaucoup ensemble.
cards.english: We used to laugh a lot together.

cards.target: Nous adorions les vacances d'été.
cards.english: We loved summer vacation.

cards.target: Il conduisait toujours très prudemment.
cards.english: He always drove very carefully.

cards.target: Ils semblaient très heureux ensemble.
cards.english: They seemed very happy together.

cards.target: Nous le connaissons depuis l'enfance.
cards.english: We've known him since childhood.

cards.target: Ils faisaient du camping chaque été.
cards.english: They used to go camping every summer.

cards.target: Elle se change avant le dîner.
cards.english: She changes clothes before dinner.

cards.target: Tu t'es levé tôt ce matin.
cards.english: You got up early this morning.

cards.target: Il venait nous voir chaque week-end.
cards.english: He used to come see us every weekend.

cards.target: Ils travaillaient ensemble depuis plusieurs années.
cards.english: They had been working together for several years.

cards.target: Elle dormait quand l'alarme s'est déclenchée.
cards.english: She was sleeping when the alarm went off.

cards.target: Ils jouaient aux cartes tous les vendredis.
cards.english: They used to play cards every Friday.

cards.target: Je me sentais fatigue après le travail.
cards.english: I felt tired after work.

cards.target: Tu te souvenais de cette chanson ?
cards.english: Did you used to remember this song?

cards.target: Tu étais content de ton travail ?
cards.english: Were you happy with your job?

cards.target: Tu voyageais souvent pour le travail ?
cards.english: Did you use to travel often for work?

cards.target: Elle croyait que la Terre était plate.
cards.english: She believed the Earth was flat.

cards.target: Tu te rappelles l'adresse de l'hôtel ?
cards.english: Do you remember the hotel's address?

cards.target: Tu habitais dans quelle ville avant ?
cards.english: Which city did you use to live in before?

cards.target: Tu aimais quel genre de musique ?
cards.english: What kind of music did you use to like?

cards.target: Il souriait toujours quand il nous voyait.
cards.english: He used to always smile when he saw us.

cards.target: Je descendais les escaliers quatre à quatre.
cards.english: I used to run down the stairs.

cards.target: Elle promettait toujours de venir nous voir.
cards.english: She used to always promise to come visit us.

cards.target: Nous utilisions des cartes routieres pour voyager.
cards.english: We used to use road maps to travel.

cards.target: Je les connais tous par leur prenom.
cards.english: I know them all by their first name.

cards.target: Nous courions dans les champs après l'école.
cards.english: We used to run in the fields after school.

cards.target: Nous écoutions la radio pendant le trajet.
cards.english: We used to listen to the radio during the trip.

cards.target: Je nageais dans la rivière en été.
cards.english: I used to swim in the river in the summer.

cards.target: Ils aimaient se promener au bord du lac.
cards.english: They liked to walk by the lake.

existing_tips: le / la → l' before a vowel: l'homme, l'eau. Possessives flip too: ma → mon before a vowel, so "mon
'Tous les dimanches' (every Sunday) is a clear habit marker → imparfait is the right tense.
Pouvoir in imparfait describes a past ability or possibility: il pouvait = he could.
'Déjà' + imparfait describes a state that was already true: 'tu savais déjà' = you already knew.
'Toujours' or 'souvent' in past context → imparfait (habitual). 'Un jour' or 'soudain' → passé compo
Connaître (to know/be familiar with) is irregular: je connais, tu connais, il connaît, nous connaiss
Reflexive verbs in PC: elle s'est coupé. Imparfait for the background action.
States and feelings use imparfait (avais faim). Completed actions use PC (es rentre).
Dining (ongoing activity) vs lights going out (sudden event). The tense contrast tells the story.
Voulais (imparfait) = ongoing desire. A ferme (PC) = completed event that changed things.
Double pronouns: me + le becomes me l'. Order: me/te/se/nous/vous + le/la/les.
Reflexive verbs use a pronoun: me, te, se, nous, vous, se. Je me lève = I get myself up.
'Je voudrais' (conditional of vouloir) is the polite way to say 'I would like'. More polite than 'je
Age in the past uses imparfait (avais). Moving is a completed event: PC (as demenage).
